summary: Add a special that appears and disappears on its own.
content:
1. In the sidebar on the far left, select the **Collections** icon, then **Specials**.
2. At the top right, select **+ New Object**.
3. In the first box, enter the name of the special, such as "Soft-shell Crab Sandwich".
4. Set **Starts** to the first day you'll offer it.
5. Set **Ends** to the last day you'll offer it. For a one-day special, use the same date as **Starts**.
6. Enter the **Price**, using numbers only.
7. Write one or two sentences in **Description**.
8. Add a **Photo** if you have one.
9. Scroll to the bottom and select **Save**.

## Why isn't my special showing?

The dates have to include today, or the special won't show. A special dated for next week stays hidden until its **Starts** date, and it disappears by itself after its **Ends** date.

That means you can set up next week's special today and leave it alone.

If you need to pull one early, read [End a special early](ext/totalcms/client-help/post/end-a-special-early).
